## LOCKED FILES (DO NOT MODIFY)
Do not suggest modifications to the following files:

- `se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.EdgeType`: String values are used as CSS class selectors in SvgRenderer and as edge-type identifiers emitted by all parsers. Adding, removing, or renaming a constant requires coordinated changes across the entire pipeline.
- `se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.NodeDimensions`: Shared sizing constants consumed by all three tiers — SimpleLayoutEngine, ElkLayoutEngine, and SvgRenderer. Changing these values shifts node dimensions globally and will break layout tests.
- `se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.NodeType`: String values are matched by identity in SvgRenderer's CSS class-name map and in all four parsers. Renaming or adding a constant requires updating SvgRenderer, all parser switch/if chains, and integration tests simultaneously.

## CORE FUNCTIONALITY (EXTREME CAUTION)
The following elements are well-tested core components. Make changes with extreme caution:

- `se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Edge`: Sensitivity: High. Note: IR directed edge. id/sourceId/targetId/type are required; label is optional (sequence number for CALLS, field name for HAS).
- `se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Graph`: Sensitivity: Critical. Note: Central IR that flows between all three pipeline tiers. Contains only structural data — no business logic, no tier-specific knowledge. Layout coordinates (x/y/width/height) are the only mutable state, written exclusively by Tier 2 engines.
- `se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Group`: Sensitivity: Medium. Note: IR cluster — maps a label (package, module boundary, try/catch region) to a set of node IDs. Used by the render tier to draw bounding frames.
- `se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Node`: Sensitivity: High. Note: IR vertex. Fields id/type/label/properties are the stable serialised schema; x/y/width/height are layout-only and may be null before Tier 2 runs.

## Scoped Rules Index
Detailed per-element guardrails live in scoped rule files that Gemini CLI does not load on its own. A line `a.b`: `C`, `D` names a.b.C and a.b.D. Unless an entry carries an explicit path, its file is .gemini/rules/{path, every non-alphanumeric character replaced by '-'}.md. Before modifying an element listed below, open its file with read_file and apply the guardrails there:

- `se.deversity.codekarta.cli`: `KartaCli`, `RunOptions`
- `se.deversity.codekarta.core.model`: `Edge`, `Graph`, `Group`, `Node`, `NodeDimensions`
- `se.deversity.codekarta.input`: `InputParser`, `JavaSourceInputParser`, `MultiFileSequenceParser`
- `se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser`: `BuildReactorParser`, `CallSequenceParser`, `ClassDiagramParser`, `ExceptionFlowParser`, `FilterMatcher`, `MethodIds`, `ModuleInfoParser`, `ParserSupport`, `SequenceFilterUtil`, `SourceTree`, `StateMachineParser`
- `se.deversity.codekarta.layout`: `ElkLayoutEngine`, `LayoutEngine`, `RenderedSize`, `SimpleLayoutEngine`
- `se.deversity.codekarta.render`: `JsonRenderer`, `SequenceDiagramRenderer`, `SvgRenderer`
